title: Cornucopias - COPI Cafe Episode 19
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Rob and Josh discuss the new Cornucopias Cardano stake pool and the token release schedule for the team and advisors. The guys also touch on the NFT2Tree mint and how well the marketplace performed. Later in this episode they are joined by Kyle of DripDropz who shares his background in the Cardano ecosystem and many exciting collaborations between Cornucopias and DripDropz. The episode ends with a leak that blows Kyle away. Stay tuned to the end for an exciting announcement!

Stay until the end for some game asset leaks. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. Crack open your favorite beverage, enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

Fair disclaimer: COPILeaks are brief glimpses into the game's mechanics as they currently stand. Everything we leak can be assumed to be unfinished, is subject to change, or may never be seen again. So enjoy it while you can, and be sure to share this COPILeak with everyone you know!
